verdict.rationale: Cal.com documents the agent scheduling flow in API v2. Agents can query available slots by username and event slug, and create bookings through POST /v2/bookings, which needs no auth for booking on behalf of external users. A reschedule endpoint covers accepted and pending bookings. A hosted MCP server at mcp.cal.com also lets agents manage bookings from any MCP client. Cancellation is only implied, by a BOOKING_CANCELLED webhook trigger and the MCP server's general "manage bookings" wording. missing for 10: an explicit cancel-booking API/MCP endpoint in the evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end agent flow, a published OpenAPI spec (probe 404).
